zh: 一条开放的折角轮廓占据图像的上部和中部。
左侧竖向上升，并连接一条较长的上部横向笔画。
另一条内部笔画在中央附近先斜向再向下延伸。
右侧外部笔画向下延伸，并向左下方弯曲。
下端以细而不规则的横向或斜向末端伸出。
左下边缘附近有一个小型分离深色点状残片。
en: An open angular outline occupies the upper and middle image.
The left side rises vertically into a long upper horizontal stroke.
A second inner stroke runs diagonally and then downward near the center.
The right outer stroke descends and bends toward the lower left.
The lower end extends as a thin, uneven horizontal or diagonal terminal.
A small detached dark speck appears near the lower-left margin.
These observations describe visible marks only; no component, variant, or reading is assigned.
